item.title: Gas prices in Tri-State area continue to increase due to Iran conflict
item.description: The price of a regular gallon of gas shot up 19 cents, to $3.24, on the NJ Turnpike and Garden State Parkway, at 7 a.m. Friday. It was $3.05 on Wednesday and $3 on Monday.

item.title: Don't be a victim of extortion! Know the signs for Consumer Protection Week
item.description: It's National Consumer Protection Week, and 7 On Your Side is helping consumers dodge fraud and extortion.

item.title: Mayor Mamdani unveils new rules to remove unnecessary scaffolding across New York City
item.description: The 1,400 residents of Highbridge Gardens in the Bronx have been living in the shadows for years. Their day-to-day lives, eclipsed by a network of steel frames and wooden planks.

item.title: Man convicted in U.S. political assassination plot he tied to Iranian paramilitary
item.description: The jury needed little more than two hours to convict Asif Merchant, 47, of murder-for-hire and terrorism charges that carry the possibility of life in prison.

item.title: New York City pop-up features the most bizarre items discovered in lost luggage
item.description: "Unclaimed Baggage" opens a pop-up shop in Manhattan, selling people's unclaimed, bizarre items they've purchased from airlines.

item.title: Secrets of the stars ahead of the Oscars: Picture perfect poses, the right dress and more
item.description: Celebrities are prepping for their moment on the red carpet -- and it turns out it takes a whole lot of effort to look effortless.

item.title: Oscar-nominated 'The Devil Is Busy' looks at women's reproductive rights
item.description: One of this year's Oscar-nominated documentary shorts is "The Devil Is Busy," a half hour film about reproductive rights.

item.title: Casting nominee reacts to Oscars' first new category in 25 years
item.description: This new category is one that's behind-the-scenes, but without it, there could be no movie magic. Once there's a script, there needs to be actors to play the roles. That's where casting directors come in.

item.title: Crews discover what appears to be human remains in Queens
item.description: The remains were spotted late Friday afternoon in the Jamaica Bay Wildlife Refuge.

item.title: Dozens of residents displaced after partial roof collapse at Bloomfield apartment building
item.description: Officials say the collapse occurred at the northeast corner of the roof due to water damage, which impacted one apartment directly.
